title: 第十章 九层舰楼之下第十一章 幽云散开鬼荒世界
lines: 青铜船舰的甲板区很长。
二人沿舷墙，在冥雾中，走了快一公里，金乌尸骸才渐渐清晰起来。
尸骸一只羽翅盖在甲板区的碑林中，一只搭在九层高的舰楼上。九婴那样的巨兽与它相比，都略显娇小了。
已经死在此处不知多少年月，但尸体没有冰冷，金灿灿的，有火光流动。
站在百米外，都能感受到一阵阵热浪从尸身的方向涌来。
金乌尸骸的每一根羽毛，都比成人身体更大数十倍，流光溢彩，甚是瑰美，不敢想象它还活着时是何等璀璨。
莫非真如神话传说中一般，能化为巡游天地的太阳？
它身上的致命伤，位于头颅，是被未知利器贯穿，形成一个三米长的恐怖血窟窿。
种植用的金乌血，是从血窟窿下方一个直径二十多米的血潭中打取。刚打上来的时候，桶中血的温度，接近沸水，需要经过特殊处理才能冷却。
李唯一站在血潭边观察，金乌的血，鲜红中带有淡淡金芒。
血味很浓，但并不刺鼻。
反而有一股惹人生津的血气之香。
若不是金乌有“毁灭之鸟”的不好名声，让人心生敬畏，科考队员们早就无所顾忌的开饮。
“难怪他们都想吞饮，喝金乌的血，肯定跟吃烤肉一样鲜香。而且，还有长生不老的可能性，真是让人疯狂。”
高欢忍不住吞咽口水，又道：“这要是在地球上，一滴金乌血出世，就能让所有富豪为之豪掷万金，我们这里可是有一整潭。你赶紧施展美男计，去问蔡博士啊，咋们高校不都流传那么一句话，学弟若想学姐爱，要么多金要么帅。”
“满嘴顺口溜，你想考……考博吗？”李唯一笑道。
或许是刚刚修炼出超凡的名堂，身体急需高等物质补充，他滋生出来的食欲，比高欢还要强烈。
甚至，右足足心的滚烫气流，不受控制的主动涌出，在十三条痕脉中流动，仿佛在催促他赶紧饮金乌血。
“诱惑越大，便越危险。”
李唯一将体内的滚烫气流压了回去，赶紧离开血潭。
另一边，黑蛟是被利器斩断成两截，尸身甚是粗壮，比李唯一的身体都高出许多。
一块块鳞片，犹如蒲扇大小的厚实铁皮，散发冰寒气息。
蛟身断切处，鲜血凝结成紫红色冰晶，需要用斧头才能凿下来，然后再加热融化。
黑蛟尸骸附近，横七竖八躺着许多身穿铠甲的白骨人类。
705实验室的六人，正围在其中一具较为特殊的白骨人类旁边研究，勾画结构图，记录铠甲上的铭文和花纹。
这具白骨人类特殊在于，骨头像夜光石般散发淡淡微光，已经金属化，摸上去十分光滑，敲击起来，就像敲铁块。
听到脚步声，705实验室的六人齐刷刷看向李唯一和高欢。
高欢很自来熟，笑声询问：“杨主任，有什么发现没有？”
六人中，那位持霰弹枪的魁梧男子，寸头发型，身高接近两米，双手紧了紧，眼神颇为警惕。见是两个出来散步的伤患，才稍微放松了一些。
显然各方都感受到青铜船舰上气氛的不对劲，不再像曾经那般相互信任。
杨主任还算和善，笑道：“死在青铜船上的，显然都不是寻常生灵，科学难以解释。地上这些人骨，身上穿的铠甲，至少有千斤重，我们六个合力都挪移不动。”
“兵器也很沉重，最轻的那杆长枪，竟需要两个人才能勉强抬起，密度很大，也不知是何种材质。”

;;
The bronze ship had a long deck area.
The two walked along the bulwark for almost a kilometer in the mist, and then the Golden Crow's corpse gradually became clear.
One of the corpse's wings is covered in the forest of steles in the deck area, and the other is resting on the nine-story ship building. Compared with it, giant beasts like Jiuying are slightly petite.
He has been dead here for who knows how many years, but his body is not cold, it is golden, and there is light flowing.
Standing a hundred meters away, you can feel waves of heat coming from the direction of the corpse.
Each feather of the Golden Crow's corpse is dozens of times larger than an adult's body, and it is extremely beautiful. I can't imagine how dazzling it was when it was alive.
Could it really be like the myths and legends that it can turn into the sun that travels around the world?
The fatal wound on its body was located on its head, which was penetrated by an unknown sharp weapon, forming a three-meter-long terrifying blood hole.
The Golden Crow blood used for planting was extracted from a blood pool with a diameter of more than 20 meters below the blood cave. When it was first pumped out, the temperature of the blood in the bucket was close to boiling water, and it needed special treatment to cool it down.
Li Weiwei stood by the blood pool and observed that the blood of the Golden Crow was bright red with a faint golden glow.
The smell of blood is strong, but not pungent.
On the contrary, there is a refreshing scent of blood.
If it weren't for the fact that the Golden Crow has a bad reputation as the "Bird of Destruction", which makes people feel in awe, the scientific expedition team members would have started drinking without any scruples.
"No wonder they all want to drink it. Drinking the blood of the Golden Crow must be as delicious as eating barbecue. Moreover, there is also the possibility of immortality, which is really crazy."
Gao Huan couldn't help but swallow his saliva, and said: "If on earth, a drop of Golden Crow blood was born, all the rich would spend tens of thousands of dollars on it. We have a whole pool here. Quickly use your beauty trick and ask Dr. Cai. Isn't there a saying in our colleges and universities that if a junior wants to be loved by his senior, he must either have a lot of money or be handsome."
"You're full of jingles, do you want to take...the Ph.D. exam?" Li Weiwei smiled.
Perhaps because he had just cultivated extraordinary skills and his body was in urgent need of high-quality supplements, his appetite was even stronger than Gao Huan's.
In fact, the hot air flow from the center of his right foot surged out uncontrollably and flowed through the thirteen veins, as if urging him to drink the Golden Crow blood quickly.
“The greater the temptation, the greater the danger.”
Li Weiwei suppressed the hot air in his body and quickly left the blood pool.
…
On the other side, the black dragon was cut into two pieces by a sharp weapon. The body was very thick, much taller than Li Weiwei's body.
The scales are like thick iron sheets the size of cattail leaf fans, exuding an icy air.
Where the dragon's body was severed, the blood condensed into purple-red ice crystals, which required an ax to be chiseled out and then heated to melt.
Near the corpse of the black dragon, many white-skeletal humans wearing armor were lying in random directions.
Six people from the 705 laboratory were studying around one of the more special skeletal human beings, sketching the structure and recording the inscriptions and patterns on the armor.
What's special about this white-bone human is that the bones emit a faint shimmer like luminous stone. They have been metalized and feel very smooth. When struck, it is like striking an iron block.
Hearing the footsteps, the six people in the 705 laboratory all looked at Li Weiwei and Gao Huan.
Gao Huan was very familiar with him and asked with a smile: "Director Yang, have you discovered anything?"
Among the six people, the burly man holding a shotgun had short hair and was nearly two meters tall. His hands were tightened and his eyes were quite wary. Seeing that they were two injured people who were out for a walk, they relaxed a little.
Apparently all parties felt something was wrong with the atmosphere on the bronze ship, and they no longer trusted each other as they once did.
Director Yang was quite kind and said with a smile: "Those who died on the bronze boat were obviously not ordinary creatures, and it is difficult for science to explain. These human bones on the ground, and the armor they wore, weigh at least a thousand kilograms, and the six of us can't move them together."
"The weapons are also very heavy. The lightest spear requires two people to lift it. It is very dense and I don't know what kind of material it is made of."
title_en: Chapter 10 Under the nine-story ship building Chapter 11 The dark clouds disperse into the ghostly world
